audit_scope.method: Read-only SDK package/source inspection, readelf and targeted strings; current v7 rootfs read through debugfs without -w

ddk.kernel_requirement: Matching pvrsrvkm Services ABI, build options, BVNC and firmware; an upstream powervr node alone does not establish proprietary ABI compatibility

x11_apis: GBM including modifier and per-plane FD exports
Mesa DRI entry points pvr, sunxi_drm, zink
wayland_apis: Vulkan IMG ICD and WSI layer
buildroot_bundle.warning: Keep the chosen winsys bundle coherent; identical DDK filenames do not imply byte-identical x11, wayland or Debian-build libraries.

debian_package_integration_findings.basic_libc_compatibility: Target glibc 2.41 supplies a newer versioned ABI; this does not prove full dependency or graphics protocol compatibility.
debian_package_integration_findings.prerm_postrm: Stop, mask or purge lightdm.service state
debian_package_integration_findings.bundled_service: /lib/systemd/system/lightdm.service with display-manager.service alias and vendor LD_LIBRARY_PATH
debian_package_integration_findings.glvnd: No __egl_Main export in audited vendor libEGL, and no vendor libGLX or EGL GLVND JSON found. Treat as a complete legacy stack, not a GLVND plug-in.
debian_package_integration_findings.native_opengl_gap: libpvr_dri_support references libGL_PVR_MESA.so, but that module was not found in either SDK IMG bundle or the Debian package. A libGL/GLX loader does not prove native accelerated desktop OpenGL.
debian_package_integration_findings.zink: Buildroot 10.3 x11 DRI exports zink; audited Debian package does not.
debian_package_integration_findings.firmware_difference: Debian rgx.fw differs from Buildroot and historical baseline despite the same BVNC filename. Do not substitute based only on filename.

mutter48_gles_x11.conclusion: GNOME/Mutter 48 has a GLES2 plus EGL_XLIB path for an Xorg session. Missing libGL_PVR_MESA.so does not make Wayland or Zink mandatory.
source_behavior: src/backends/x11/meta-renderer-x11.c lines 57-67 maps GLES2 to EGL_XLIB and GL3 to GLX.
cogl/cogl/cogl-renderer.c accepts COGL_DRIVER=gles2. Default selection prefers GL3; a custom winsys does not establish automatic fallback after GL3 failure.
meson.build enables EGL_XLIB when EGL and X11 are enabled.
cogl-winsys-egl-x11.c implements X11 window surfaces and EGL image/pixmap texture handling.
mutter48_gles_x11.runtime_status: Capability supported by source and installed binary; vendor EGL/GLES GNOME session not run in this audit.

findings: Historical baseline records identify pvrsrvkm rogueddk24.2@6603887 and report Weston IMG BXM OpenGL ES3.2.
Historical Debian/Armbian adaptation records explicitly leave GPU runtime validation pending; the first Debian boot failed in ATF.
A reported Buildroot Weston baseline does not prove GNOME48/Xorg, Linux6.18, this Debian package or present firmware selection.

recommended_next_candidate.priority: Retain GNOME48 Xorg and fixed 1080p60; first investigate the coherent vendor x11 EGL/GLES stack with COGL_DRIVER=gles2.
recommended_next_candidate.packaging: Inherit SDK bundle selection and DDK dependencies in an isolated candidate package/directory without LightDM hooks. Preserve the working software-rendering image and recovery.
minimum_coherent_stack: Vendor libEGL, libGLESv2, libglapi and libgbm
Matching libpvr_dri_support, libsrv_um and compiler/USC modules
Matching kernel Services ABI and selected rgx firmware
recommended_next_candidate.environment: Scope vendor library/DRI paths and COGL_DRIVER=gles2 to the candidate. Existing LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=true and GALLIUM_DRIVER=llvmpipe must be absent from the GPU experiment session. Preserve rollback; shell profile LD_LIBRARY_PATH alone may not reach both GDM and the desktop.
acceptance_sequence: Validate kernel, BVNC, firmware and render node first.
Validate vendor EGL X11, GLES context, renderer string and buffer sharing before GNOME.
Reassess current Xorg AccelMethod none and DRI/pixmap import availability; GLES support alone does not prove accelerated composition.
Validate GDM, normal-user login, GNOME and app windows at 1080p, then logout/relogin and reboot.
recommended_next_candidate.fallbacks: Wayland EGL/GLES or Vulkan/Zink remain alternatives if X11 sharing fails; neither is established as required.

small_configs../lib/systemd/system/lightdm.service:
[Unit]
Description=Light Display Manager
Documentation=man:lightdm(1)
After=systemd-user-sessions.service

# replaces plymouth-quit since lightdm quits plymouth on its own
Conflicts=plymouth-quit.service
After=plymouth-quit.service

# lightdm takes responsibility for stopping plymouth, so if it fails
# for any reason, make sure plymouth still stops
OnFailure=plymouth-quit.service

[Service]
#IMG GPU LIB PATH
Environment="LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/lightdm
Restart=always
BusName=org.freedesktop.DisplayManager

[Install]
Alias=display-manager.service
